observations.behavior: Adds a new Django management command, person_inspect, to inspect Postgres and ClickHouse state for explicit persons and distinct IDs.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides an operational command for PostHog support and engineering to diagnose discrepancies between Postgres and ClickHouse identity records, including history and activity, without modifying production state.

observations.behavior: Adds Inspection dataclass and helper functions to classify and inspect person and mapping records, including history and activity.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a structured representation of inspection results, including Postgres and ClickHouse states, history, and activity, to support diagnostics and debugging of identity discrepancies.
